title: Todo Quote Action Read Permission Consistency

items.action: load and render the existing quote
load template content tags and items

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing backend endpoint authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only the Todo Detail action visibility is aligned with the existing Quote Editor read contract.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The Quote Editor route guard already enforces the same read contract; this change aligns the originating action.

notes: Todo Detail previously showed the Teklifi Hazırla action for every teklif task even when the current user could not satisfy the Quote Editor's six protected read dependencies. The action now reuses the same canReadQuoteEditor contract through a dedicated action helper, so users are not offered navigation that the route guard must immediately reject. Quote create/update authorization remains unchanged.
